text: Quick recap. Look at the scatter diagram first. Karl Pearson's r, between minus one and one, measures straight line correlation and ignores changes of origin and scale. Spearman's formula works with ranks. The two regression lines meet at the means, their slopes multiply to r squared, and you predict y with the line of y on x.
